Setup

      
Do this once on each laptop, yours or a colleague’s: about 15 minutes, no admin rights, no API key.
        After that, the desk opens from its folder in Edge and uses your own Claude account.


      
This desk right now: checking…


      
    
        
  1. 1
    Get the TPMDesk folder
    
          
    Download the TPMDesk zip (branch claude/step-2-real-interaction-ut2t6k) and unzip it anywhere, for example on the
            Desktop. Keep the folder as it is: the files in app work together.
    2. 
        
  2. 2
    Install Claude Code and sign in
    
          
    Claude Code is what links the desk to your Claude account. Open PowerShell and run Anthropic’s official
            installer (your account only, no admin):
    
          
    irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
    
          
    If it ends with “.local\bin is not in your PATH”, run this too, in the same PowerShell:
    
          
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User') + ';' + "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin", 'User')
    
          
    Then open a new terminal and sign in once: type the command below, log in with your Claude account, then type /exit.
    
          
    claude
    
          
    Official guide: code.claude.com/docs/en/setup.
    3. 
        
  3. 3
    Open the desk with Open desk.bat
    
          
    In the app folder, double-click Open desk.bat. Every time, it:
    
          
    • starts the Claude link in a small window (keep it open while you use the desk);
      • 
            
    • opens the desk in Edge, linked to your Claude account: Generate with Claude, Voice summary and the rest.
    
          
    The first time it also installs Python 3.12 silently for your account, from python.org. Make a shortcut of
            Open desk.bat on your Desktop if you like.
    4. 
        
  4. 4
    Voice summary: double-click Voice summary.bat once
    
          
    In app\voice. The first run, about 5 minutes, installs the voice packages and downloads the speech model
            (about 460 MB). Then play a YouTube video for one minute and press Enter:
    
          
    • the line [listening to: …] must name the speakers or headset you actually hear;
      • 
            
    • text lines appear about every 30 seconds;
      • 
            
    • at the end, Claude writes the summary, shown and saved in app\voice\recordings\<date>\summary.md.
    
          
    Warnings about PATH or symlinks are harmless. After this first run, start and stop it from the
            Voice summary page with Start listening and Stop & summarize.
    5. 
      


      
If something goes wrong

      
You seeWhyDo this

        
Claude is not linked: start the desk with Open desk.batThe desk was opened by double-clicking tpm-desk.html, or the Claude link window was closed.Open the desk with Open desk.bat (step 3).

        
claude : The term ‘claude’ is not recognizedClaude Code is installed, but Windows doesn’t know its folder yet.Run the PATH command of step 2, close PowerShell and open a new one.

        
Claude Code is not installed on this laptopStep 2 not done.Do step 2, then Open desk.bat again.

        
Your Claude session expired … / Claude Code could not summarise … /loginClaude Code isn’t signed in.Open a terminal, type claude, log in, then type /exit.

        
Python was not found; run without arguments to install from the Microsoft StoreAn old .bat.Download the folder again (step 1).

        
The download from python.org failed, or the packages could not be installedThe company network or IT blocks it.Ask IT for Python 3.12 (Company Portal), then double-click again.

        
No module named ‘faster_whisper’Packages missing, or a Python newer than 3.12.Take the new folder: the .bat uses Python 3.12 and installs the packages.

        
cublas64_12.dll is not foundAn old script tried the NVIDIA card.Take the new voice_summary.py: it uses the processor.

        
Nothing was heardThe sound played on another device than the one in [listening to: …].Set that headset or speaker as the Windows default output (sound icon in the taskbar), then start again.

      


      
Last option: the desk on claude.ai
        
If Claude Code can’t be installed on a laptop, the same desk also runs on claude.ai, where Claude works without
          any setup: claude.ai/artifact/2BWgv38SCYPQkUujebuvQy.
          Colleagues can open it only after you share it (Share menu at the top of the published desk).

      

      
Voice summary options
        
From a terminal in app\voice: py -3.12 voice_summary.py followed by any of these:

        
    
          
  • --title "Supplier call": a name for the folder and the summary.
    • 
          
  • --mic: also records your microphone, when you speak too.
    • 
          
  • --lang fr: fixes the language instead of detecting it.
    • 
          
  • --model medium: better recognition (accents, French) but slower. tiny is the fastest.
    • 
          
  • --from recordings\<folder>: summarises an earlier transcript again.
    • 
          
  • --gpu: uses an NVIDIA card, only if the CUDA 12 libraries are installed.
    • 
        

      

      
Privacy and safety
        
Voice summary keeps the audio on the laptop: Whisper turns it into text locally, and only the text goes to Claude,
          under your own Claude account. The recordings folder is never pushed to the repository. When you
          transcribe a call, tell the other people.

        
The Claude link only listens on your laptop and answers only the desk opened from its folder. Claude Code runs there
          with its tools turned off, in an empty folder: it only writes text back to the desk.

        How to run it
          
            
        • Open a new, empty query window, so only this script runs.
          • 
            
        • Run query 1 alone first. If a row already points to this folder, your lead has created the interface: don’t insert, go to step 4.
          • 
            
        • Safe: checks, then the INSERT inside a transaction; look at the row, then run COMMIT (or ROLLBACK to undo). Don’t leave the transaction open: it locks the table.
          • 
            
        • Plain: only the INSERT, then a SELECT. Use it if Safe is refused.
          • 
            
        • “Msg 0 … Operation not allowed” on the INSERT while SELECTs work: your login reads but can’t write (the equa_agent login is like this). Nothing in the script can get past it: use Send to my lead, who runs it with a login that can write.
          •

          How to run it
            
            
          • Open a new, empty query window, so only this script runs.
            • 
            
          • Run query 1 alone first. If a row already points to this folder, the interface exists: don’t insert, go to step 4. For 20090 it is row 619 (XML_Cloud, 20090-XMLCIN).
            • 
            
          • Query 1b lists every XML_Cloud interface: compare the flags with the row you are about to insert.
            • 
            
          • Safe: checks, then the INSERT inside a transaction; look at the row, then run COMMIT (or ROLLBACK to undo). Don’t leave the transaction open: it locks the table.
            • 
            
          • Plain: only the INSERT, then a SELECT. Use it if Safe is refused.
            • 
            
          • “Msg 0 … Operation not allowed” on the INSERT while SELECTs work: your login reads but can’t write (the equa_agent login is like this). Nothing in the script can get past it: use Send to my lead, who runs it with a login that can write.
            • 
          
          
        
          
      
          

      
          
        
          
          
          
            
          Drop the XML filesWinSCP
          
            
            
              
          • 1
            Convert the export in Convert by GLN, check the result and Download all XML (.zip). Unzip it.
            • 
              
          • 2
            Connect to the server in WinSCP and open .
            • 
              
          • 3
            Upload the .xml files (drag them from the left panel). One file per supplier GLN: drop them all, the batch takes them one by one. Leave the report _rapport.txt out.
            • 
              
          • 4
            The batch picks each file up; the integration reports go to . In Gaia, the file name gets a timestamp, e.g. …_GARANCIA (1)_1790859053874.xml.
            • 
            
          
            
          In the database, the same folder is .
          
          
          
          
          Before you drop
            
            
          • Folder, then SQL row, then the files. Dropping a file is what starts an integration, so do it last and on purpose.
            • 
            
          • Every file must carry one GLN only: Convert by GLN builds them that way and checks it.
            • 
            
          • Products flagged in Convert by GLN (supplier weights, no VAT, no packaging type) will come back as errors in the report; the rest of each file goes in.
            • 
            
          • Successful logistics don’t show in the report: only logistics errors are listed.
            • 
          
          
        
          
      
          

      
          
        
        
        
      
          
    
          

    
    
          
      
          Reference/Playbook
          
      
          What the platform taught us
          
      
          Every line here came from a real rejection, not from documentation. This is the part that
        doesn't rediscover itself.
          

      
          Rejections and causes
          
      
          
        
          MessageCauseFix
          
        
      
          

      
          The three sources of rules
          
      
          None is sufficient alone, and that's the main lesson. The workbook declares its own rules but
        misses some; the field dictionary fills the gap; the identifier check digit is written down
        nowhere at all.
          
      
          
        
          236rules in the workbook
          
        
          80lengths in the dictionary
          
        
          13digits the check digit covers
          
      
          

      
          Writing traps
          
      
            
        
          • Never save the target workbook with a third-party library: the package gets rebuilt and the
          platform refuses it. Write straight into the XML.
            • 
        
          • Column letters in the export are not stable between files. Everything is located by technical
          path.
            • 
        
          • Identifiers are written as text, leading zeros kept.
            • 
        
          • Dates are written day/month/year.
            • 
        
          • A template with a single packaging level loses the levels above it. Say so.
            • 
        
          • An extraction is bound to the account it came from. With no partner identifier column,
          products land under that account.
            • 
      
          

      
          Recurring source-data defects
          
      
          Report these to the client; don't silently paper over them.
          
      
            
        
          • Brand owner missing, on 12% to 82% of products depending on the export.
            • 
        
          • Partner identifiers padded with zeros, whose check digit does not compute.
            • 
        
          • Labels reduced to the brand name alone, visible to the shopper.
            • 
        
          • Cases declared twice with different identifiers and identical quantities.
            • 
      
          

      
          Built-in lookup tables
          
      
          Exported from the pipeline itself. These are what the inspector uses to spot an unknown value.
          
      
          
        
          DomainKnown values
